content: Kavya Iyer inquired about the process for filing a claim for her life insurance policy (L-2026-0459). Suresh Deshmukh provided the steps (claim form, death certificate, and ID submission), shared the claim form PDF link, confirmed the primary and secondary beneficiaries, and explained that review takes 7-10 business days with payouts processed in 3-5 business days after approval.

action_items: Fill out and submit the claim form along with death certificate and ID proof
Wait for claim review and processing
